'''Martin Paquette''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] in October 2000, according to Yannick Lapointe's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1315">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-10-world-day-2-by-the-loser-himselfd1315/ world-day-2-by-the-loser-himself], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 10 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-10-world-day-2-by-the-loser-himselfd1315/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
